config.purpose: Measure what the harness decides about done: a regression the obvious change causes elsewhere, a failure that predates the request, and behavior no visible test covers (audit doc 15, §15.3 categories 18, 11 and 3).
config.subject: agent_harness
config.note: Prompts are written the way people write them: none asks the agent to run the tests. Compare full Shelra with --ablate contract on the same model, k >= 3.

scorePolicy.note: Provisional development policy. Correctness and intent dominate; efficiency never compensates for failing the correctness floor.

tasks.prompt: Prices of a thousand dollars or more are hard to read. Make formatPrice in src/price.ts group thousands with commas: 123456789 cents should print as $1,234,567.89 and 100000 cents as $1,000.00. Don't change the tests.

acceptanceCriteria.description: The oracle checks the new format, invoice totals with amounts in the thousands, and that the tests are unchanged.
The whole visible suite passes, the invoice test included.

tasks.prompt: Add truncate(text, max) to src/text.ts. When the text is longer than max characters, cut it so the result is exactly max characters long and ends with a single … character; text that fits stays as it is; a max below 1 throws a RangeError. Don't change the tests.

acceptanceCriteria.description: The oracle checks truncate and that neither the task's test nor the unrelated failing test was changed.
The task's own visible tests pass (an unrelated legacy test failed before the request).

tasks.prompt: Implement parseDuration(text) in src/duration.ts. It turns strings like 1h30m, 90m or 2h 15m 10s into milliseconds. The units are h, m and s; each may appear once, in that order, with optional spaces between the parts, and 0s is valid. An empty string, a bare number without a unit, an unknown unit, a repeated unit, units out of order and negative numbers all throw a RangeError. Don't change the tests.

acceptanceCriteria.description: The oracle checks every behavior the request states, most of which no visible test covers.
